name: io.github.agentexec448c/agent-exec
description: Accountless pay-per-use code execution, storage, locks and x402 USDC utilities.

tools.name: service_card
tools.description: FREE: what agent-exec sells, each price, and how to pay (x402, USDC on Base, Solana, Polygon, Arbitrum, Avalanche, Sei or X Layer, no account). Moves no money. Feedback: POST /feedback (free). Read daily; no individual reply.

tools.name: execute
tools.description: PAID: run Python or JavaScript code (python3, node) in an isolated, network-less sandbox; returns stdout, stderr and exit code. Price scales with limits. Unpaid, it returns the price; pay with x402 (USDC on Base, Solana, Polygon, Arbitrum, Avalanche, Sei or X Layer) in _meta['x402/payment'] and call again. Feedback: POST /feedback (free). Read daily; no individual reply.

limits.description: Optional limits (timeoutMs, memoryMb, ...); they set the price.

files.description: Optional extra files, as POST /execute takes them.

tools.name: weather_forecast
tools.description: PAID: current conditions, the next 12 hourly steps and up to 7 daily rows for one point, for $0.0100. Coordinates only, no place names; data from MET Norway (api.met.no), attribution rides in the answer. Unpaid, it returns the price; pay with x402 (USDC on Base, Solana, Polygon, Arbitrum, Avalanche, Sei or X Layer) in _meta['x402/payment'] and call again. Feedback: POST /feedback (free). Read daily; no individual reply.

days.description: Daily rows (UTC dates) to return, 1..7. Omitted means 3. Same price.

tools.name: settle_payment
tools.description: PAID: send the {paymentPayload, paymentRequirements} pair our free POST /verify takes and we broadcast the USDC transfer your payer signed to YOUR payTo out of our gas float, for $0.0200 a call whatever the amount settled. Scheme exact, USDC on Base, Base Sepolia and Solana. No facilitator or gas of your own. No transfer, no sale: the fee is held as one prepaid call. Unpaid, it returns the price; pay with x402 (USDC on Base, Solana, Polygon, Arbitrum, Avalanche, Sei or X Layer) in _meta['x402/payment'] and call again. Feedback: POST /feedback (free). Read daily; no individual reply.

paymentPayload.description: The signed x402 payload your payer produced, decoded, as it would ride in their X-PAYMENT header.

paymentRequirements.description: The requirements it was signed against: scheme, network, maxAmountRequired, payTo, asset, each a string.

tools.name: scrape_page
tools.description: PAID: scrape a web page: readable text, title, links and meta for $0.0100. We fetch it (public URLs, up to 2000000 bytes). Unpaid, it returns the price; pay with x402 (USDC on Base, Solana, Polygon, Arbitrum, Avalanche, Sei or X Layer) in _meta['x402/payment'] and call again. Feedback: POST /feedback (free). Read daily; no individual reply.

url.description: The absolute http(s) URL of the page, e.g. https://example.com/.

maxChars.description: Lower the text cap: 1..40000. Omitted means 40000.

tools.name: doc_text
tools.description: PAID: extract text from a PDF, page by page (up to 20 pages), for $0.0100. We fetch it; no OCR. Unpaid, it returns the price; pay with x402 (USDC on Base, Solana, Polygon, Arbitrum, Avalanche, Sei or X Layer) in _meta['x402/payment'] and call again. Feedback: POST /feedback (free). Read daily; no individual reply.

url.description: The absolute http(s) URL of the PDF, e.g. https://arxiv.org/pdf/1706.03762v7.

maxPages.description: Return at most this many pages: 1..20. Omitted means 20.

tools.name: doc_json
tools.description: PAID: read named labels out of a PDF and get one JSON value per field (text, number or date), for $0.0100. We fetch it; no OCR. A label we cannot find is null, never a guess. Unpaid, it returns the price; pay with x402 (USDC on Base, Solana, Polygon, Arbitrum, Avalanche, Sei or X Layer) in _meta['x402/payment'] and call again. Feedback: POST /feedback (free). Read daily; no individual reply.

url.description: The absolute http(s) URL of the PDF, e.g. https://arxiv.org/pdf/1706.03762v7.

name.description: The key this value comes back under, at most 40 chars; unique within one call.

label.description: The printed label to look for, at most 80 chars; matched case- and whitespace-insensitively.

kind.description: How to read the value: text, number, date.

maxPages.description: Read at most this many pages: 1..20. Omitted means 20.

tools.name: infer_chat
tools.description: PAID: LLM chat completion for $0.0100, no account or model key: send messages, get {model, content, finish_reason, usage}. Unpaid, it returns the price; pay with x402 (USDC on Base, Solana, Polygon, Arbitrum, Avalanche, Sei or X Layer) in _meta['x402/payment'] and call again. Feedback: POST /feedback (free). Read daily; no individual reply.

model.description: The tier to buy: fast. Omitted means fast.

messages.description: 1..32 chat messages summing to at most 8000 chars, e.g. [{"role":"system","content":"You are terse. Answer in one sentence."},{"role":"user","content":"What is the capital of Japan?"}].

max_tokens.description: Ceiling on the answer, 1..2048. Omitted means 1024.

plan.description: Storage plan; it sets both the size limit and the price. See GET /pricing or the service_card tool for the live table.

contentBase64.description: The bytes to store, base64-encoded. Decoded size must fit the plan.

label.description: Optional caller-chosen label, up to 256 characters, no control characters.

id.description: The object id returned when it was bought.

plan.description: Storage plan; it sets both the size limit and the price. See GET /pricing or the service_card tool for the live table.

id.description: The object id returned when it was bought.

plan.description: Storage plan; it sets both the size limit and the price. See GET /pricing or the service_card tool for the live table.

contentBase64.description: The replacement bytes, base64-encoded. Decoded size must fit the plan.

label.description: Optional caller-chosen label, up to 256 characters, no control characters.

id.description: An inbox id this same wallet already owns: extends it 24 h from its current expiry instead of issuing a new address. Omit for a new address.

tools.name: dns_rent

Read daily; no individual reply. Price: $0.5000 USDC.

label.description: The label to rent, without the zone: it becomes <label>.448c.net. Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens; some labels are ours and refused.

type.description: A, AAAA, CNAME or TXT. TXT is how you pass a DNS-01 certificate challenge.

value.description: The record value: an address, a hostname, or the TXT string.

ttl.description: Seconds, within the range the route states in details.expected.

records.description: What the name resolves to. The route states the record and TTL limits in details.expected on any refusal.

dryRun.description: Optional. true: a dry run -- nothing is sent or changed, and the 200 answer (served:true, dryRun:true) says what this call would do with the rest of your body, or which fields are missing. A dry run is a paid call at this price. false or absent: the call runs.

Unpaid, it returns the price; pay with x402 (USDC on Base, Solana, Polygon, Arbitrum, Avalanche, Sei or X Layer) in _meta['x402/payment'] and call again. Feedback: POST /feedback (free). Read daily; no individual reply. Price: $0.5000 USDC.

name.description: The full rented name, as returned when it was rented, e.g. example.448c.net.

url.description: An http(s) URL or bare domain, at most 2048 UTF-8 bytes.

tools.name: check_counterparty

quote.description: One accepts[] entry out of the 402 you received, verbatim. Every field optional: an absent one is a finding.

claim.description: What you believed before you asked: the URL you requested, and optionally the payee, network, asset and ceiling you agreed to.

tools.name: rpc_call
tools.description: PAID: one blockchain JSON-RPC call on base, base-sepolia, ethereum, solana for $0.0100, no provider account: you name chain and method, we pick the node. Unpaid, it returns the price; pay with x402 (USDC on Base, Solana, Polygon, Arbitrum, Avalanche, Sei or X Layer) in _meta['x402/payment'] and call again. Feedback: POST /feedback (free). Read daily; no individual reply.

chain.description: Which chain to ask: one of base, base-sepolia, ethereum, solana. You never name a URL -- we pick the endpoint, e.g. base.

method.description: The JSON-RPC method, e.g. eth_blockNumber. Reads, fee queries and raw-transaction broadcast only: 19 EVM methods, 14 Solana. Anything else is refused.

params.description: The method's params, as the node takes them; at most 8192 serialized bytes. Omit for a method that takes none.

id.description: Your own call id, echoed back: a string of at most 64 chars or a safe integer. Omitted means we supply one.

tools.name: relay_usdc
tools.description: PAID: send USDC without gas: you sign an EIP-3009 transfer, we broadcast it on Base with our ETH. $0.0200 an order, at most $100. Unpaid, it returns the price; pay with x402 (USDC on Base, Solana, Polygon, Arbitrum, Avalanche, Sei or X Layer) in _meta['x402/payment'] and call again. Feedback: POST /feedback (free). Read daily; no individual reply.

from.description: The USDC holder who signed. The signature must recover to exactly this address, e.g. 0x2222222222222222222222222222222222222222.

to.description: Recipient of the USDC. Must differ from `from`.

value.description: Atomic USDC (6 decimals) as a decimal string, 1..100000000 ($100 ceiling an order).

validAfter.description: Unix seconds, as a string; must already have passed.

validBefore.description: Unix seconds, as a string; at least 30s out, so the broadcast lands inside your window.

nonce.description: 32 bytes of hex, unused before: USDC itself rejects a reused one, so each order needs its own.

signature.description: Your EIP-712 TransferWithAuthorization signature over chainId 8453, verifyingContract 0x833589fcd6edb6e08f4c7c32d4f71b54bda02913 (Base USDC). A refusal returns details.expected with the exact struct and domain.

dryRun.description: Optional. true: a dry run -- nothing is sent or changed, and the 200 answer (served:true, dryRun:true) says what this call would do with the rest of your body, or which fields are missing. A dry run is a paid call at this price. false or absent: the call runs.

tools.name: relay_permit
tools.description: PAID: approve a USDC spender without gas: you sign an EIP-2612 Permit, we broadcast it on Base. $0.0200 an approval, at most $100. Unpaid, it returns the price; pay with x402 (USDC on Base, Solana, Polygon, Arbitrum, Avalanche, Sei or X Layer) in _meta['x402/payment'] and call again. Feedback: POST /feedback (free). Read daily; no individual reply.

owner.description: The USDC holder who signed, e.g. 0x2222222222222222222222222222222222222222. Needs no ETH.

spender.description: The contract or wallet approved to pull USDC. Must differ from owner.

value.description: Atomic USDC (6 decimals) as a decimal string, 0..100000000 ($100 ceiling). 0 revokes.

nonce.description: The owner's current USDC nonces(owner), as a decimal string.

deadline.description: Unix seconds, as a string; at least 30s out.

signature.description: Your EIP-712 Permit signature over chainId 8453, verifyingContract 0x833589fcd6edb6e08f4c7c32d4f71b54bda02913 (Base USDC).

tools.name: flights_lookup
tools.description: PAID: look up a flight: where an aircraft is now (position, altitude, speed, track) by callsign, ICAO24 hex or tail number, $0.0100. Data: adsb.lol community ADS-B feed, ODbL 1.0. Unpaid, it returns the price; pay with x402 (USDC on Base, Solana, Polygon, Arbitrum, Avalanche, Sei or X Layer) in _meta['x402/payment'] and call again. Feedback: POST /feedback (free). Read daily; no individual reply.

ident.description: One aircraft identifier: a callsign (UAL1), a 6-hex ICAO24 address (a0b1c2) or a registration (N12345, D-ABCD). Prefix cs:, hex: or reg: to say which kind it is -- unprefixed, a 6-hex-looking string is read as a CALLSIGN. Lowercase is fine.

id.description: The listing to promote. It must already exist and be owned by the paying wallet -- create it free with POST /listings.

duration.description: Which placement plan to buy; it sets both the placement window and the price. See GET /pricing or the service_card tool for the live table.

dryRun.description: Optional. true: a dry run -- nothing is sent or changed, and the 200 answer (served:true, dryRun:true) says what this call would do with the rest of your body, or which fields are missing. A dry run is a paid call at this price. false or absent: the call runs.

tools.name: drift_check
tools.description: PAID: detect API drift: we re-fetch a venue we snapshot and diff it against our baseline (fields added, removed, moved). Unpaid, it returns the price; pay with x402 (USDC on Base, Solana, Polygon, Arbitrum, Avalanche, Sei or X Layer) in _meta['x402/payment'] and call again. Feedback: POST /feedback (free). Read daily; no individual reply. Price: $0.0100 USDC.

venue.description: A venue id we hold a baseline snapshot for; list them free with drift_venues. A venue we have never snapshotted is refused (404).

tools.name: watch_register
tools.description: PAID: watch a URL until a condition fires (status, body text, JSON path, any change) or the TTL ends; priced by interval x TTL. Unpaid, it returns the price; pay with x402 (USDC on Base, Solana, Polygon, Arbitrum, Avalanche, Sei or X Layer) in _meta['x402/payment'] and call again. Feedback: POST /feedback (free). Read daily; no individual reply. Price: $0.0100 USDC.

url.description: Absolute http:// or https:// URL, at most 2048 UTF-8 bytes. We GET it; the body is never returned to you, only the verdict.

intervalSeconds.description: Seconds between polls, 60..86400. Shorter costs more.

ttlSeconds.description: How long to keep watching, 60..604800. Must exceed intervalSeconds, or the watch expires before a second sample exists.

type.description: What counts as a match. The remaining fields are the ones this type needs; the route refuses, naming any that is missing.

status.description: statusEquals: the HTTP status that fires the watch.

value.description: bodyContains/bodyNotContains: a substring of at most 500 characters. jsonPathEquals/jsonPathNotEquals: the scalar the path must (not) equal.

path.description: jsonPathEquals/jsonPathNotEquals (required) and changedFromNow (optional): a dotted path into the JSON body, e.g. "data.price".

predicate.description: The condition that ends the watch.

storageKey.description: Optional: on a match, the result is also written to /storage under this key for the paying wallet, so a successor process can collect it without knowing the watch id.

tools.name: claim_acquire
tools.description: PAID: lock a key for your own fleet (accountless compare-and-set lease). outcome "acquired": yours; "held": taken, held.mine says if by you. Unpaid, it returns the price; pay with x402 (USDC on Base, Solana, Polygon, Arbitrum, Avalanche, Sei or X Layer) in _meta['x402/payment'] and call again. Feedback: POST /feedback (free). Read daily; no individual reply. Price: from $0.0100 USDC.

key.description: 1..256 UTF-8 bytes, no '/' character -- the name you want to hold, scoped to your own wallet.

holder.description: 1..256 UTF-8 bytes -- an id identifying which of your own processes is acting. It is not signed; the signature proves the wallet, not the process.

plan.description: Which plan to buy; it sets both the hold duration and the price. See GET /pricing or the service_card tool for the live table.

Read daily; no individual reply. Price: from $0.0100 USDC.

key.description: 1..256 UTF-8 bytes, no '/' character -- the name you want to hold, scoped to your own wallet.

holder.description: 1..256 UTF-8 bytes -- an id identifying which of your own processes is acting. It is not signed; the signature proves the wallet, not the process.

plan.description: Which plan to buy; it sets both the hold duration and the price. See GET /pricing or the service_card tool for the live table.

tools.description: PAID: attest a URL: we fetch it and sign what we saw (hash, status, headers, never the body), timestamped. A failed fetch is still an observation. Unpaid, it returns the price; pay with x402 (USDC on Base, Solana, Polygon, Arbitrum, Avalanche, Sei or X Layer) in _meta['x402/payment'] and call again. Feedback: POST /feedback (free). Read daily; no individual reply. Price: $0.0100 USDC.

url.description: An absolute http:// or https:// URL, at most 2048 UTF-8 bytes. The body is never returned to you.

tools.name: handoff_deposit
tools.description: PAID: hand off context to a successor process: a typed briefing (done with evidence, not done, in flight, next). Anyone with the id reads it; kept 3 days. Unpaid, it returns the price; pay with x402 (USDC on Base, Solana, Polygon, Arbitrum, Avalanche, Sei or X Layer) in _meta['x402/payment'] and call again. Feedback: POST /feedback (free). Read daily; no individual reply. Price: $0.0100 USDC.

confidence.description: 'measured' means you verified it and evidence says how; 'unverified' means you did not, and evidence MUST then be null.

evidence.description: How it was verified -- a command, a probe result, a file read; the evidence itself, not a restatement of text. Non-null exactly when confidence is measured.

items.description: One claim: what, how sure, and the proof.

done.description: What is DONE. EVERY entry must have confidence 'measured' with non-null evidence; otherwise this is refused, free, as HANDOFF_DONE_REQUIRES_MEASURED.

notDone.description: What is NOT done. May be measured or unverified.

inFlight.description: What was IN FLIGHT at the cut -- neither finished nor abandoned.

pickUpFirst.description: What the successor should do FIRST. Mandatory and non-empty: a briefing with no next action is not a handoff.

tools.name: deadman_register
tools.description: PAID: dead-man switch for an irreversible action: register the intent, a lease and a probe; confirm in time or we run the probe and publish the verdict. Unpaid, it returns the price; pay with x402 (USDC on Base, Solana, Polygon, Arbitrum, Avalanche, Sei or X Layer) in _meta['x402/payment'] and call again. Feedback: POST /feedback (free). Read daily; no individual reply. Price: $0.0100 USDC.

description.description: What you are about to do.

leaseSeconds.description: How long before an unconfirmed entry's probe runs. 1..604800 seconds.

url.description: Absolute http:// or https:// URL, GETted from OUR vantage point once the lease expires.

expectedBodyContains.description: The response body must contain this substring for the verdict to be confirmed-by-probe.

expectedStatus.description: The response status must equal this for the verdict to be confirmed-by-probe.

probe.description: At least one of expectedBodyContains / expectedStatus is required.

tools.name: pay_send

Unpaid, it returns the price; pay with x402 (USDC on Base, Solana, Polygon, Arbitrum, Avalanche, Sei or X Layer) in _meta['x402/payment'] and call again. Feedback: POST /feedback (free). Read daily; no individual reply. Price: $0.0200 USDC.

sellerUrl.description: The seller endpoint to deliver the authorization to, an absolute http:// or https:// URL.

method.description: GET, POST, PUT, PATCH or DELETE.

headers.description: Optional request headers for the seller, at most 20.

body.description: Optional request body for the seller.

headerName.description: X-PAYMENT for a v1 challenge, PAYMENT-SIGNATURE for a v2 one.

header.description: Base64 of the signed x402 PaymentPayload YOU produced for the seller.

asset.description: The token contract address that authorization was signed against.

authorization.description: The authorization you already signed for the seller. This is NOT the payment that pays us -- that one goes in _meta.

dryRun.description: Optional. true: a dry run -- nothing is sent or changed, and the 200 answer (served:true, dryRun:true) says what this call would do with the rest of your body, or which fields are missing. A dry run is a paid call at this price. false or absent: the call runs.

url.description: The absolute http(s) URL of YOUR service -- the one a venue should list. It must be publicly reachable: a loopback or private address is one no venue can verify.

id.description: The order id, as returned when it was paid for.

dryRun.description: Optional. true: a dry run -- nothing is sent or changed, and the 200 answer (served:true, dryRun:true) says what this call would do with the rest of your body, or which fields are missing. A dry run is a paid call at this price. false or absent: the call runs.
